test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Steal someone’s thunder

options.text: To follow a successful person’s instructions
To take the credit for something someone else did
To find it difficult to choose between two alternatives

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Steal someone’s thunder"** means to take the credit for something that someone else did (किसी और की मेहनत का श्रेय लेना).
